workspace.title: Workspace
workspace.description: Your active tenant context, usage, and quick links. Multi-tenant controls apply per organization.
workspace.card_body: When you connect a backend, this view can show tenant name, plan, seat usage, and SSO status. Admins manage members under Tenant admin.

projects.title: Projects
projects.description: Track initiatives across your workspace with optional tenant isolation.
projects.card_body: Wire this to your API to list projects filtered by tenant and role.

team.title: Team
team.card_body: Standard users see teammates; invite flows can be added with your auth provider.

documents.title: Documents
documents.card_body: Connect object storage or a CMS when ready.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.description: Alerts across apps and tenants you belong to.
notifications.card_body: Hook to websockets or polling for real-time updates.

help.title: Help center
help.description: Guides and support for both end users and admins.
help.card_body: Replace with your knowledge base or Intercom embed.

tenant_members.title: Members & roles
tenant_members.description: Invite users and assign roles within this tenant (organization admin).
tenant_members.card_body: Map roles to Supabase or your IdP; enforce least privilege for production.

tenant_audit.title: Tenant audit log
tenant_audit.description: Security-relevant events for this organization only.
tenant_audit.card_body: Export to SIEM or store immutably for compliance.

tenant_billing.title: Tenant billing
tenant_billing.description: Plans, invoices, and payment methods for this tenant.
tenant_billing.card_body: Sync Customer ID per tenant for correct invoicing.

admin.title: Platform administration
admin.description: Cross-tenant operations — use only for super-admins.
admin.card_body: Protect these routes with server-side checks and separate roles in production.

admin_users.title: All users
admin_users.description: Every user across all tenants (platform scope).
admin_users.card_body: Paginate and filter; never expose PII without audit logging.

admin_tenants.title: Tenants
admin_tenants.card_body: Each tenant id should map to isolated data stores or schemas.

admin_audit.title: Platform audit
admin_audit.card_body: Retention policies differ from tenant-level audit logs.

admin_api_keys.title: API keys
admin_api_keys.description: Service accounts and integration keys for the platform API.
admin_api_keys.card_body: Store hashes only; show plaintext once at creation.

admin_reports.title: Reports
admin_reports.description: Exports and scheduled analytics across tenants.
admin_reports.card_body: Connect BigQuery or Metabase when datasets are ready.

settings.title: Settings
settings.description: Manage your account settings and preferences.

security.title: Security
security.description: Protect your account with additional verification.
security.two_factor_description: Add a second step after your password when you sign in.
security.two_factor_hint: 2FA will be available when your workspace enables identity providers.

dashboard.title: Welcome Back
dashboard.description: Here is what's happening with your projects today.

auth.login_description: Sign in to your account to continue

auth.signup_description: Fill in the fields below to register

auth.error_not_implemented: HTTP auth is not wired yet. Set NEXT_PUBLIC_AUTH_DRIVER=mock or implement http.provider.ts.

auth.toast_forgot_success: If that email exists, we sent reset instructions.
auth.toast_reset_success: Password updated. You can sign in with the new password.
auth.toast_reset_no_token: Open this page from the email link that includes a reset token.
